as_told.title: Jolly West, UCLA and MK Ultra

plain: The psychiatrist Jolly West, longtime head of psychiatry at the University of California, Los Angeles, is said to have been one of the architects of MK Ultra, a secret CIA program of mind-control experiments, and to have exchanged letters with Sidney Gottlieb, the CIA chemist behind it. Jesse Michels tells this across three episodes, drawing on the psychiatrist Colin Ross's book CIA Doctors and the journalist Tom O'Neill's book Chaos, and he goes further to suggest West was probably using such methods on the cult leader Charles Manson. If true, it would tie a government mind-control program to the making of a cult.
